cross_parity_vanishing.statement: K_{ij}^{01}(tau) = L_i^0 G_tau S_j^1 = 0 and K_{ij}^{10}(tau) = L_i^1 G_tau S_j^0 = 0 for ALL node pairs (i,j) and any K-equivariant regularization
cross_parity_vanishing.proof: P commutes with K^* (K is a background isometry). S_j^1 is K-odd. G_tau preserves K-parity. G_tau S_j^1 is K-odd. L_i^0 is K-even (extracts K-even component of curvature). Inner product of K-even functional with K-odd field = 0.
cross_parity_vanishing.scope: geometric, not just flat V_2 level; valid after Bianchi correction, cutoff, curved parametrix, and all Ozuch radial corrections, as long as they respect the K-equivariance of the construction
cross_parity_vanishing.consequence_for_self_singularity: Even-odd diagonal self-terms K_{ii}^{01} and K_{ii}^{10} vanish by K-symmetry alone, not requiring matched subtraction or regularization limit

negative_mode.proof: K-parity orthogonality: K-odd source has zero L2 inner product with K-even eigenfunction, for ANY source in the K-odd sector

scalar_zero_modes.proof: same K-parity argument as for q

geometric_annihilation.scope: full geometric, valid for the complete Bianchi-compatible source in the K-equivariant construction, not just the flat V_2 principal term

symmetry_comparison.KJ_relation: KJ = JK = K_B (conjugation on second sphere only), and K = K_A, J = K_A K_B

consequence_for_relative_interaction.simplified_formula: Delta_eps(tau) = sum_{i!=j} a_i b_j (eps_i eps_j - 1) K_{ij}^{11}(tau)
consequence_for_relative_interaction.no_cross_parity: K^{01}_{ij} = K^{10}_{ij} = 0 for all i,j by K-symmetry
consequence_for_relative_interaction.no_diagonal_singularity: odd-odd diagonal: eps_i^2 - 1 = 0; even-odd diagonal: vanishes by K-symmetry
consequence_for_relative_interaction.surviving_computation: off-diagonal odd-odd Green kernel at distinct nodes (finite)
consequence_for_relative_interaction.sign_not_determined: K-symmetry eliminates all singularities and cross terms but does not determine the sign of the surviving interaction
